property_summary: After any successful transferFrom(id), the token's owner must become the recipient (ownerOf(id)==to); the mutant never updates _ownerOf, so ownerOf stays the old owner for some transfer.

For any admissible input, once an NFT is transferred via transferFrom, the previous owner can no longer transfer it again (ownership actually moved); the mutant leaves _ownerOf unchanged, so the old owner can transfer the same token a second time.

For any signed order, filling it a second time must revert because the position id was already minted, so ownerOf(hashOppositeOrder(order)) permanently remains the first filler; the mutant re-mints and steals the id, reassigning ownership to the second filler.

Transferring an owned token leaves every untouched balance untouched, and in particular a self-transfer of a token must leave the owner's token balance exactly unchanged: the reference conserves the sender's balance on transferFrom, while the mutant skips `_balanceOf[from]--` so a self-transfer inflates the sender's balance by one.

For any order, a token owner self-transferring a minted position NFT must leave their token balance exactly unchanged (transferFrom conserves the sender's balance); the mutant skips _balanceOf[from]--, so a self-transfer inflates the sender's balance and breaks this conservation for a filled order.
